tasks.subject: Task 0: Project scaffold, DI composition, and WebApplicationFactory test harness
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the `EMaigrator.Api` project (referencing Core, Infrastructure, connectors), a `Program`/`AppBuilder` wiring Identity + EF + SignalR + auth + Swagger, and a reusable `ApiTestFactory` spinning a real in-process server against Testcontainers Postgres.

**Files:**
Create: src/EMaigrator.Api/EMaigrator.Api.csproj, src/EMaigrator.Api/Program.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/AppConfiguration/ApiServiceCollectionExtensions.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/appsettings.json, src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/EMaigrator.Api.Tests.csproj, src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/Infrastructure/ApiTestFactory.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/Infrastructure/PostgresFixture.cs
Test: src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/ScaffoldSmokeTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- EMaigrator.Api.csproj references only Core, Infrastructure, and the three connectors (dependency rule honored).
- Program.cs exposes `public partial class Program {}` for WebApplicationFactory.
- ApiTestFactory boots against Testcontainers Postgres and runs EF migrations.
- GET /health returns 200 with JSON containing `status`.
- Builds with dotnet build and smoke test passes.

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~ScaffoldSmokeTests` -> all pass.

tasks.subject: Task 1: ApplicationUser + Identity registration/login (cookie + JWT)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Define `ApplicationUser : IdentityUser<Guid>` with `TenantId`, and ship `/api/v1/auth/register` (creates Tenant + user) and `/api/v1/auth/login` (issues a JWT carrying the `tenant_id` claim + sets an auth cookie).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- ApplicationUser : IdentityUser<Guid> has Guid TenantId (CONTRACTS §5).

tasks.subject: Task 2: JWT/cookie authentication + ICurrentTenant accessor + tenant global query filter
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Wire JWT-bearer + cookie auth, an `ICurrentTenant` accessor from the `tenant_id` claim, and apply the EF Core global query filter so tenant-scoped reads are confined to the caller's tenant (cross-tenant -> 404).

**Files:**
Create: src/EMaigrator.Api/Tenancy/ICurrentTenant.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/Tenancy/HttpContextCurrentTenant.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/Tenancy/TenantQueryFilterRegistration.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/Infrastructure/TestCurrentTenant.cs
Modify: src/EMaigrator.Api/AppConfiguration/ApiServiceCollectionExtensions.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/Program.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/Infrastructure/ApiTestFactory.cs
Test: src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/TenancyFilterTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- ICurrentTenant.TenantId returns the tenant_id-claim Guid; throws UnauthorizedAccessException when unauthenticated.
- AppDbContext (Plan 03) applies global query filter j => j.TenantId == _tenantProvider.TenantId for Job; API supplies per-request ITenantProvider.
- A Job seeded for tenant B is null when queried as tenant A.
- Default authorization policy requires an authenticated user; AllowAnonymous still lets /health + auth through.

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~TenancyFilterTests` -> all pass.

tasks.subject: Task 3: MigrationDto + Migrations CRUD + Draft autosave (endpoints PATCH)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Ship `MigrationDto` (exact CONTRACTS §6 camelCase shape) and core CRUD/draft routes: POST /migrations (Draft, wizardStep=1), GET /migrations (?status=&q=), GET /migrations/{id}, DELETE /migrations/{id} (204), PATCH /migrations/{id}/endpoints — all tenant-scoped, 404 cross-tenant.

**Files:**
Create: src/EMaigrator.Api/Contracts/MigrationDto.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/Contracts/MigrationRequests.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/Mapping/MigrationMapper.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/Endpoints/MigrationEndpoints.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/Infrastructure/AuthClient.cs
Modify: src/EMaigrator.Api/Program.cs
Test: src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/MigrationCrudTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- POST /migrations with {} returns 201 + MigrationDto status=Draft, wizardStep=1; persists Job with caller TenantId.
- MigrationDto JSON keys exactly: id,status,wizardStep,from,to,isBatch,scopeSummary,mailboxCount,progress,createdAt (camelCase).
- GET /migrations?status=Draft returns only the caller's Draft jobs; ?q= filters by provider text.
- GET /migrations/{id} for another tenant -> 404.
- PATCH /endpoints {from:imap,to:graph} advances wizardStep>=2.
- DELETE -> 204; unauthenticated -> 401.

tasks.subject: Task 4: PUT connection/{side} (store creds via ISecretStore) + POST connection/{side}/test (provider TestConnection + catalog-mapped errors)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement PUT /migrations/{id}/connection/{side} (stores non-secret settings on Job + secret via ISecretStore.StoreAsync, never echoing the secret) and POST /migrations/{id}/connection/{side}/test (builds connector via IProviderPlugin, calls TestConnectionAsync, maps failures through IErrorCatalog.Match into a stable errorCode).

**Files:**
Create: src/EMaigrator.Api/Contracts/ConnectionRequest.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/Services/IConnectionService.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/Services/ConnectionService.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/Endpoints/ConnectionEndpoints.cs
Modify: src/EMaigrator.Api/AppConfiguration/ApiServiceCollectionExtensions.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/Program.cs
Test: src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/ConnectionEndpointsTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- PUT connection/from stores secret via ISecretStore + saves secretRef+settings to Job.SourceConnectionRef; response body contains no occurrence of the literal secret.
- side must be from|to else 400.
- POST connection/from/test calls IProviderPlugin.CreateSource.TestConnectionAsync, returns verbatim ConnectionTestResult.
- On failure, raw signature maps via IErrorCatalog.Match to a stable code (not a stack trace).
- Cross-tenant id -> 404; unauthenticated -> 401.

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~ConnectionEndpointsTests` -> all pass.

tasks.subject: Task 8: POST approve (persist resolutions, enqueue via IJobOrchestrator) + pause/resume/cancel
tasks.description:

Modify: src/EMaigrator.Api/Data/ApiSideContext.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/Program.cs

tasks.subject: Task 12: CORS lock-down + security headers + auth-endpoint rate limiting
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Lock CORS to configured origins, add a security-headers middleware (CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy), and apply a per-IP fixed-window rate limiter to the auth endpoints (brute-force guard).

**Files:**
Create: src/EMaigrator.Api/Security/SecurityHeadersMiddleware.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/Security/RateLimitPolicies.cs
Modify: src/EMaigrator.Api/AppConfiguration/ApiServiceCollectionExtensions.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/Program.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api/Endpoints/AuthEndpoints.cs
Test: src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/SecurityHardeningTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Every response carries X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy: no-referrer, and a CSP header; HTTPS responses carry HSTS.
- CORS allows the configured origin and rejects an unconfigured origin (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin).
- auth rate-limit policy named 'auth' attached to /auth/register + /auth/login; exceeding the window returns 429.
- Normal API routes unaffected by the auth limiter.

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~SecurityHardeningTests` -> all pass.

tasks.subject: Task 13: Security Verification (USER-ORDERED GATE)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the API's security focus: tenant isolation enforced; all non-public routes require auth; no secret values in any response; input validation; CORS locked; security headers present; auth endpoints rate-limited.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in acceptanceCriteria has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
Create: src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/Security/RouteAuthSweepTests.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/Security/CrossTenantAccessTests.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/Security/NoSecretInResponseTests.cs, src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/Security/InputValidationSweepTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Auth sweep test enumerates every non-public route under /api/v1/migrations* plus /hubs/migrations and asserts 401 with no token; captured output lists each route + observed 401.
- Tenant isolation: tenant B gets 404 on GET/PATCH/PUT/POST/DELETE for tenant A's migration AND a SignalR Subscribe to it throws.
- No secrets in responses: a stored secret string is absent from GET /migrations/{id}, PUT connection/from response, POST connection/from/test, GET audit, GET report?format=csv (NotContain assertion per body).
- Input validation: malformed bodies (missing required field, bad enum, blank CSV, unknown side) each return 400-422, never 500; captured per-case status.
- CORS locked: preflight from an unconfigured origin yields no Access-Control-Allow-Origin (re-asserted).
- Security headers present on an arbitrary route (re-asserted).
- Auth rate limit trips 429 on rapid /auth/login (re-asserted).
- All four security test classes pass; captured dotnet test output attached to close-out.

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~EMaigrator.Api.Tests.Security` -> all pass.

tasks.subject: Task 14: Functional Verification — end-to-end wizard happy path against the live API
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the headline behavior end-to-end: an authenticated operator drives a full migration through the REST surface (create draft -> set endpoints -> connect both sides -> test -> scope -> preflight -> approve -> results -> report), receiving live SignalR progress and a terminal email — against the in-process API with a fake provider + recording orchestrator + inline preflight.

**Files:**
Create: src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests/Functional/FullWizardFlowTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- A single test walks register/login -> POST /migrations (Draft, step 1) -> PATCH endpoints -> PUT connection/from + /to -> POST connection/from/test ok=true -> PUT scope -> POST preflight (202) -> GET preflight returns plan -> POST approve (Running, enqueued) -> bridged terminal MigrationProgressEvent -> subscribed SignalR client receives Progress + StatusChanged(Completed) -> GET results reconciles counts -> GET report?format=pdf returns a PDF.
- Orchestrator recorded exactly one enqueue per mailbox.
- Terminal-state notifier sent exactly one email (capturing IAppEmailSender).
- Whole flow runs without any 5xx (every intermediate response asserted success/202/200).

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~FullWizardFlowTests` -> all pass.
